patterns.note: The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while a secondary category filter bar scrolls up and then also becomes sticky directly below the primary navigation.
A prominent, full-width carousel occupies the initial hero section, showcasing featured website examples with subtle dot and arrow navigation.
The main content area is structured as a dense, multi-column grid of website thumbnail cards, each displaying a small image, title, and metadata.
Small, uppercase sans-serif text is consistently used for category labels, metadata, and filter options, providing clear hierarchical distinction.
A stark, high-contrast color scheme relies on an off-white background and dark gray text, punctuated by a single bright red accent for interactive elements and branding.
Interior pages feature a large hero image of the showcased website, followed by a 'Similar Websites' section that reuses the main content grid layout.

technique_notes: The site employs a two-tiered sticky header system: a primary navigation bar is always fixed at the top, and a secondary filter bar scrolls into view and then locks below the primary header, providing persistent access to content filtering.
Website examples are presented within a responsive grid layout, where each item is a card containing a screenshot thumbnail, title, and descriptive text, designed for easy scanning and navigation.
The initial viewport features a large, interactive carousel that cycles through featured design examples, using subtle visual cues for navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clear and distinct, but not overly large, maintaining a balanced relationship with the body text. Labels are consistently small and uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and buttons, giving a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density in the main content grid, with more airy spacing in the hero and footer sections.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its highly organized and visually rich showcase of web design examples, presented through a clean, minimalist interface. The dual-sticky header system, combining main navigation with a persistent category filter, provides an efficient browsing experience for a large volume of content.
